prediction.correction_1_text: EXP-029 prediction: by the pre-registered rule (smallest T with under 1 unnecessary landing per hour, at 20 Hz), the formula gives T = 0.15 s on iid_1 and 0.2 s on iid_5, not 0.3 s; iid_10 gives 0.3 s (0.065 per hour at 0.3 s). Corrected prediction: 0.15 s (iid_1), 0.2 s (iid_5), 0.3 s (iid_10), 0.5 s (iid_30), none up to 2 s on the 0.5 s burst presets and on burst_10_0.2s probably 1.0 to 2.0 s. The rule is also constrained to T >= T_w + 0.05 s. The late-reaction rate is reported beside it.
prediction.prediction_source: pre-registered before the runs (EXP-029 section of the private pre-registration)
prediction.prediction_text: at 20 Hz the 300 ms rule (m = 6) is calm on clean, iid_1, iid_5 (iid_5: 3600*20*0.95*0.05^6 = 0.001 per hour) and iid_10 (0.068 per hour), noisy on iid_30 (about 36 per hour) and useless on every 0.5 s burst preset (burst_10_0.5s about 400 per hour; mean bad sojourn 0.5 s is longer than 0.3 s so most bursts trip it). No T up to 2 s gets burst_10_0.5s under 1 per hour (bursts start about 720 times per hour: mean cycle 0.5 s bad + 4.5 s good; the bad sojourn is about exponential with mean 0.5 s, so P(sojourn > 2 s) = e^-4 = 0.018, about 13 per hour at T = 2 s; at T = 0.3 s, e^-0.6 = 0.55, about 400 per hour). Late reactions: separation violations during a blind hold will happen on the jinking and figure-eight targets regardless of T, because a held follower cannot get out of the way; their rate rises with T (longer blind time in the target's plane). Hold vs slow: slow keeps closing on a stale point, so it will raise violations near a moving target. Expected recommendation: T = 0.3 s on clean and iid presets up to 10 %, T = 0.5 s at iid_30, and "no single timeout works" for 0.5 s bursts, where the fix must be elsewhere (better link, or a reversible hold instead of a landing).

rules.hand_check_verdict: z = (observed - expected) / sqrt(expected); agrees if |z| <= 4 when at least 10 events are expected
rules.late_airborne_at_blackout: the same rate over runs whose follower had not landed before the blackout (a follower grounded by link loss cannot react late)
rules.late_reaction: separation violation (true distance < 0.5 m) during the blackout or within 3 s after it, or the follower still NOMINAL when its command age reaches 0.33 s during the blackout
rules.mission_observed_landings: count landings before the blackout; exposure per run = min(first landing, blackout start) when the follower landed before the blackout, else the blackout start; one run per seed and cell, the first in grid order (class turn, figure8, jink; blackout 0.5 s, 2.0 s, permanent), because the pre-blackout link history does not depend on the class or blackout length
rules.outage_reaction: outage_reaction_*: time from the newest command received before the blackout to the transition; outage_*_link_age_s: the drone's own command age at it
rules.recommendation: smallest T with under 1 unnecessary landing per hour in Part A at 20 Hz, age rule, T_w 0.15 s, T >= T_w + 0.05 s
